attributes.board_name: Pennsylvania State Board of Occupational Therapy Education and Licensure

rules.accepted_credit_types: Continued competency activities acceptable under 49 Pa. Code §§42.51–42.57 (list on the Board's website).
rules.new_licensee_rule: Exempt from the 24 hours at the first renewal (e.g. initial license issued 7/1/2023–6/30/2025 for the 2025 renewal); the child-abuse training is still due.
rules.audit_note: Child-abuse course completion is reported electronically by the Act 31-approved provider; the Board does not accept licensee-uploaded certificates for it. Professional liability insurance is required for an active license.

topics.who: Act 31 mandated child abuse recognition and reporting training from a Board-approved provider, every biennial period; counts toward the 24

rules.legal_basis: 49 Pa. Code §§42.51–42.57; Act 31 of 2014 (Child Protective Services Law)
rules.notes: Biennial licenses expire June 30 of odd-numbered years (last renewal June 30, 2025; next June 30, 2027). Renewal fee $55 OT, $45 OTA (2025 guide).
